title: Cart Fragments
recommendation: Optimize cart fragments for better performance.

success.title: Cart Fragments Status
success.details: Currently using {value}. Low fragment count indicates good performance. Cart fragments are used to update mini-cart contents without page reloads, but fewer fragments means better performance.
steps: Current configuration is optimized for performance
Monitor fragment count during high traffic
Consider disabling if mini-cart isn't essential

error.title: High Cart Fragment Usage
error.details: Currently using {value}. High number of cart fragments may impact your site's performance. While cart fragments enable dynamic mini-cart updates, too many can slow down your site.
steps: Review if mini-cart is needed in header/menu
Consider disabling cart fragments if not required
Enable fragment caching for logged-out users

learn_more.description: Cart fragments make AJAX requests to update mini-cart contents, which can impact performance if not properly optimized.

recommended_plugins.name: WP Rocket
recommended_plugins.description: Optimize cart fragments and implement page caching
